title: Dora and the Lighthouse's Little Blink
synopsis: Dora the young seal watches a lighthouse go dark between flashes and learns to wait comfortably for its next small blink.

related_resources.reason: A simple recurring visual detail and a familiar caregiver offer a shared-reading opportunity, not a demonstrated calming effect.
Dora watches a pattern and checks whether it happens again; the source provides background for early observation, not a claim about this fiction.
